_rule: Founder rulings 2026-10-27, item 10 and ADR-0111 D7 (b), split by the founder's ruling 2026-10-30 (item 2: "re-base on this run, but split it into two ceilings — read-back calls and question calls — each at this run's value +5%"): the coach's input tokens per call of each kind in a live Define run-through (the record's summary.tokens.by_coach_class, input_tokens / calls; a coach call is a read-back call when its move is READ BACK, else a question call) may fall, never rise above its figure + the allowance, rounded down. scripts/define_runthrough.py sets a kind's figure from a complete run while it has none (the re-base) and lowers it when a complete run falls below it; test_run_records.py refuses a record above a ceiling; a figure is never edited upward. Before the split, one figure held every coach call: 6,214 (define_runthrough_20261027T140847).
